children: Artificial Intelligence Technology Solutions announced RAD will present an education session and host demonstrations at GSX 2026 across partner booths.
RAD to present "Operator 2.0" on Sept 15 at 2:45 PM ET about AI-orchestrated security operations and changing operator roles.
Circadian Risk will demo SARA Assess with RAD technology in booth 1747 to show agentic AI + risk intelligence integration.
DSI Security Services will showcase a ROSA stationary security unit in booth 2612; RAD will not have its own booth.
Company discloses FY2026 revenue $7,745,336, loss from operations $11,943,397 and auditors' going-concern qualification.
Participation and demos not expected to materially affect results; no revenue recognized from these activities to date.
